title: Schema-validated self-service export
objective: A tenant-scoped export service emits all record types in a published, versioned schema; every export is validated against that schema before release, and the schema is generated from the same definitions as the database.
owner: Product owner, Unbound (proposed role; not appointed)

title: Manifested, reconcilable exports
objective: Every export carries a manifest of record counts by type, control totals (balances, contribution and grant sums by period), event high-water mark and per-file hashes; an automated check reconciles manifest totals to the ledger before release.
owner: Product owner, Unbound (proposed role; not appointed)

title: Incremental event feed with export-grade limits
objective: A tenant-scoped, sequence-ordered event feed API and bulk snapshot endpoint have rate limits sized so a full extraction completes within the contractual window; access survives a termination flag for the transition period.
owner: Product owner, Unbound (proposed role; not appointed)

title: Verifiable migration protocol
objective: Migrations use a consistent high-water mark, record-level equivalence checks, independent ledger reconciliation and identifier mapping tables; cutover is blocked until reconciliation shows zero unexplained difference and the sponsor signs off.
owner: Product owner, Unbound (proposed role; not appointed)

title: Openly licensed interchange schema
objective: The export and interchange schema is published under an open license with versioning, and contract terms expressly permit sharing it and exports with any party.
owner: Product owner, Unbound (proposed role; not appointed)
